vagas.title: Sales Lead (Líder de Vendas) - Manaus/AM (Hybrid)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Sales Lead (Líder de Vendas) - Manaus/AM (Hybrid) em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

What you’ll do We're looking for a Sales Lead to spearhead our growth in Manaus. In this role, you'll be instrumental in expanding Clara’s footprint across both Mid‑Market and Enterprise segments by identifying new business opportunities, nurturing client relationships, and driving revenue growth. Your contributions will directly impact our mission to revolutionize spend management for companies across Latin America. Key Responsibilities Drive Regional Sales Growth: Own and execute the end‑to‑end sales cycle for both scaling Mid‑Market companies and complex Enterprise corporations in Manaus. Leverage Local Network: Use your existing relationships and deep understanding of Manaus’ business ecosystem, especially among decision‑makers in finance, operations, and procurement, to open doors and generate qualified leads. Manage Complex Deal Cycles: Navigate multi‑stakeholder procurement and legal processes typical of Enterprise clients while maintaining a high‑velocity pipeline for Mid‑Market segments. Optimize the Sales Engine: Utilize tools like HubSpot, Metabase, Amplemarket, and N8N to manage your pipeline, automate workflows, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to consistently improve conversion rates. Collaborate Cross‑Functionally: Work closely with product, risk, legal, and customer success teams via Slack and Google Drive to align market strategies, unblock complex deals, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new clients. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves Minimum 5 years of B2B sales experience managing a mix of Mid‑Market and Enterprise accounts, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Deep knowledge of the Manaus corporate landscape and an active local network among finance leaders, CFOs, and key corporate decision‑makers. Demonstrated capability to manage multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, negotiate complex agreements, and interface confidently with C‑level executives. Working proficiency in English and fluent Portuguese, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows and optimize daily outreach. Adaptability to fast‑changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate independently. Nice to haves Experience selling complex SaaS, financial technology, ERP systems, or corporate card solutions. Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python to dive into pipeline metrics and market data. Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn it. A good sense of humor. What we offer Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one. Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language). Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths. High‑ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together. Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact. Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results. Hybrid work policy Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This approach balances in‑person collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. While we do not enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, you are expected to spend time at the office organically and be present most days during your ramp‑up or when required by your leader. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Executivo(a) de Contas Estratégicas III - (Farmer)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Executivo(a) de Contas Estratégicas III - (Farmer) em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Nosso modo de fazer no time Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante. Seu Cardápio Diário Gestão Estratégica da Carteira (Foco Principal): Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de contas estratégicas composta por grandes marcas e restaurantes parceiros nas cidades de atuação. O foco principal é a atuação consultiva, construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo e ganho de confiança dos stakeholders sêniores. Atendimento e Consultoria de Vendas: Realizar diagnósticos analíticos e consultivos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e apresentar o ecossistema completo de produtos (tecnologia, financeiros, turbo, hits, totens, etc.). Análise Crítica e KPIs: Monitorar e analisar diariamente os principais indicadores de performance do negócio, tais como: pedidos, faturamento, conversão, cancelamentos, % de chamados, ROI e investimentos. Geração de Receita e Rentabilidade: Focar na rentabilização da carteira por meio da venda de múltiplos produtos/serviços (cross-sell e up-sell) e captação de alavancas de investimento/exclusividade, garantindo o crescimento do faturamento. Prospecção Oportunista (Perfil Secundário): Mapear e buscar novas oportunidades de negócios e parceiros estratégicos no mercado para complementar a gestão da carteira (Farmer/Grower), atuando de forma pontual conforme a orientação da liderança (posição com perfil majoritariamente consultivo, não sendo puramente Hunter). Rotina de Campo Disciplinada: Realizar visitas diárias e contínuas aos parceiros comerciais, mantendo uma rotina de campo intensa para garantir a proximidade e o resultado. Desenvolvimento de Mercado e Inteligência Competitiva: Monitorar tendências, concorrentes e movimentos do mercado local para adaptar estratégias comerciais e garantir a competitividade de preços e ofertas. Resolução de Conflitos Complexos: Atuar na condução de atritos, negociações complexas e resolução de problemas de forma consultiva com stakeholders sêniores dos parceiros. Ingredientes que buscamos Foco em Resultado e Autonomia: Forte senso de Dono(a), disciplina para autogestão da agenda e foco na superação de metas e resultados. Negociação e Influência: Habilidade comprovada em negociações complexas com alto poder de influência e condução de conversas consultivas com stakeholders diversos. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de prosperar em ambientes de alta cobrança, ritmo acelerado e constante mudança, mantendo a inteligência emocional. Comunicação de Alto Nível: Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza para apresentar diagnósticos e planos de ação. Domínio de IA e Tecnologia: Domínio e forte familiaridade prática com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial (como Gemini, NotebookLM) e agentes de IA para otimização de processos comerciais, construção de prompts eficientes e tomada de decisão fundamentada em dados. Google Workspace: Domínio de planilhas eletrônicas (Google Sheets, Apresentações, Formulários, Drive) para o acompanhamento e consolidação de KPIs de negócio. Sobre nós No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether. Você tem fome de que? Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando 'fora da caixa' e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade! Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. Trabalhamos em um ambiente de muita versatilidade. Sabe o que promove a nossa receita especial? As pessoas! Vem fazer parte disso Ref. 51345 #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description:

ID da Requisição: 71111 Sobre a Whirlpool Corporation Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) Ser a melhor empresa de eletrodomésticos, melhorando continuamente a vida em casa. Como a única grande fabricante de eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia dos EUA, a empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2024, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$17 bilhões em vendas anuais – quase 90% delas nas Américas – 44.000 colaboradores e 40 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e manufatura. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com. A equipe da qual você fará parte A equipe de Operações/Produção planeja, dirige e monitora todas as atividades de produção dentro de uma área ou unidade atribuída para maximizar o uso dos recursos da organização e atender às especificações de produção, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Faz a associação com os gerentes das áreas funcionais ou operacionais para entender suas necessidades de produtos atuais e futuras e desenvolver planos, estimativas de custos e cronogramas para integrar essas necessidades às atividades de manufatura existentes. Resumo desta função O Supervisor de Qualidade será responsável por liderar as equipes de inspeção, auditoria e engenharia de qualidade no chão de fábrica, garantindo a conformidade dos processos de manufatura. Trabalhará juntamente com uma equipe técnica e de operações para buscar a excelência operacional, blindagem de processos e estabilização de indicadores, transformando dados de falhas em planos estruturados de melhoria contínua. Suas responsabilidades incluirão Acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho de qualidade (KPIs) e liderar ações imediatas para conter e corrigir desvios; Suportar na implementação de Quality Control (QC) no Pilar WCM, de acordo com o route map do pilar; Supervisionar as operações diárias da equipe de qualidade no chão de fábrica, gerenciando o time de inspetores/auditores, garantindo o alinhamento com os padrões globais da empresa; Suportar e garantir a implementação das ferramentas de qualidade integradas aos pilares do WCM / Lean Manufacturing no chão de fábrica; Gerenciar recursos como pessoas, equipamentos e orçamento para otimizar as operações; Garantir que os processos produtivos operem em total conformidade com os padrões técnicos de qualidade e especificações de engenharia; Oferecer oportunidades de treinamento, desenvolvimento e feedback constante para a equipe direta, assegurando uma liderança forte e o desenvolvimento de competências técnicas e comportamentais do time; Facilitar a comunicação eficaz e a interface entre a equipe de Qualidade, Engenharia e Produção, atuando de forma estratégica para mitigar riscos de ruptura no atendimento por problemas de qualidade; Preparar relatórios executivos regulares sobre o desempenho da qualidade do processo para a alta gestão, destacando tendências de falhas, eficácia de bloqueios e planos de mitigação. Liderar projetos de redução de custos associados à não-qualidade. Requisitos mínimos Graduação em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins; Experiência prévia na indústria de manufatura (pelo menos 3 anos); Sólida experiência em ferramentas da Qualidade; Conhecimento em TPS, WCM ou Lean Manufacturing; Experiência em gestão de pessoas; Inglês Avançado Habilidades e experiências desejáveis Conhecimento em metodologia WCM; Certificações OPEx; Mentalidade voltada para resolução de problemas com base em dados; Pensamento lógico, analítico e criativo; Autodisciplina e curiosidade para aprender; Responsabilidade e trabalho em equipe; Comunicação clara; Mentalidade de melhoria contínua. O que oferecemos Gympass; Vale-Transporte, Fretados ou Estacionamento na empresa; Vale Alimentação; Refeição no local; Benefícios como empréstimo consignado ou social, plano de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida e previdência privada compatíveis com o mercado; Programa de Apoio ao Empregado, contando com atendimento 24hrs com profissionais jurídicos, sociais, financeiros, assistentes sociais e Psicólogos; Auxílio Creche ou Berçário na empresa; Serviços disponíveis na unidade: agência bancária interna, lanchonete, restaurante e sala de lactação; Duas semanas de trabalho remoto em qualquer lugar; Após 5 anos de empresa, colaboradores elegíveis podem tirar quatro semanas de licença remunerada; Desconto em produtos pelo Compra Certa; Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida Conecte-se conosco e saiba mais sobre a Whirlpool Corporation Veja como é trabalhar na Whirlpool visitando o site Whirlpool Careers. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas no Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram e YouTube. A Whirlpool Corporation está comprometida com oportunidades iguais de emprego e proíbe qualquer discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, religião, sexo, gravidez, expressão ou identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência física ou intelectual ou qualquer outra condição protegida por lei. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Engenheiro de Segurança de Produto - Trabalho Remoto
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Engenheiro de Segurança de Produto - Trabalho Remoto em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls‑Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício. Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global. Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional. Engenheiro de Segurança de Produto na BairesDev Neste papel, a habilidade diferencial é o triage prático de análise estática — não arquitetura de segurança, não gestão de pipelines DevSecOps. Se seu trabalho em segurança de produto é ler achados, rastrear o fluxo de dados através do código e tomar decisões baseadas em evidências sobre o que é real, este papel foi feito para você. Esta é sua oportunidade de aplicar experiência profunda em análise estática em um ambiente de alta responsabilidade onde a qualidade do seu triage determina diretamente como o risco é compreendido no produto. O que você fará: Realizar triage SAST prático como atividade principal diária, não como responsabilidade secundária. Fazer análise source-to-sink e revisão de código seguro. Avaliar achados com documentação baseada em evidências em um ambiente regulado. Ajustar ferramentas de análise estática e gerenciar taxas de falsos positivos no portfólio de produtos. Colaborar com equipes de engenharia para validar e corrigir vulnerabilidades confirmadas. O que estamos procurando: 5+ anos de experiência em segurança de produto, segurança de aplicações ou engenharia de software com foco prático em segurança. Histórico comprovado de triage SAST prático, não apenas integração de ferramentas ou configuração de pipelines. Sólidas habilidades de análise de fluxo de dados source-to-sink e revisão de código seguro. Experiência operando ferramentas SAST como Checkmarx, Fortify, Veracode ou Coverity. Capacidade para produzir documentação rastreável para auditoria em ambientes orientados ao compliance. Nível avançado de inglês. Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil: Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar. Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir. Hardware para você trabalhar de casa. Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário. Licença parental remunerada, férias e feriados nacionais. Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural. Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área. Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades e diversas oportunidades de crescimento. Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar! #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Road Supervisor (Mining / Access Road / Project) Amazon
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Road Supervisor (Mining / Access Road / Project) Amazon em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Road Supervisor (Mining / Access Road / Project) Amazon Job Description We are looking for a Road Supervisor, responsible for supervising the construction, rehabilitation, and maintenance of sections of a 120 km mining access road serving a remote mining project in the Amazon region. The role requires strong field leadership, hands‑on road construction expertise, and proven experience working in tropical environments characterized by heavy rainfall, challenging terrain, remote logistics, and difficult access conditions. The successful candidate will lead local work crews, coordinate equipment and subcontractor activities, ensure compliance with safety and environmental standards, and maintain road accessibility to support mining operations. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily road construction, rehabilitation, and maintenance activities on assigned road sections. Ensure works are executed according to engineering specifications, quality standards, and project schedules. Monitor road grading, drainage installation, culvert construction, embankment stabilization, erosion control, and surfacing activities. Lead and supervise local operators, laborers, foremen, and subcontractors. Organize daily work plans and allocate resources efficiently. Provide coaching, guidance, and performance feedback to team members. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to site procedures. Coordinate utilization of heavy equipment including graders, excavators, bulldozers, compactors, water trucks, and haul trucks. Monitor equipment productivity and report maintenance requirements. Ensure efficient use of materials and resources. Enforce compliance with company HSE policies and regulatory requirements. Report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions promptly. Monitor work quality and verify compliance with project specifications. Maintain daily progress reports, manpower records, and equipment utilization logs. Assist with planning upcoming work activities and resource requirements. Requirements Diploma or Technical Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction, Infrastructure, Road Works, or a related field preferred. Minimum 5 years of experience supervising road construction, rehabilitation, or maintenance projects. Experience on mining access roads, remote infrastructure projects, forestry roads, oil & gas access roads, or similar heavy civil works. Demonstrated experience working in remote tropical environments with high rainfall and challenging ground conditions. Previous experience managing local workforces in remote locations is essential. Experience in the Amazon, tropical rainforest regions, or comparable environments is highly desirable. Strong understanding of road construction methods and maintenance practices. Familiarity with heavy earthmoving equipment operations. PLUS Mining infrastructure projects Amazonian or tropical rainforest road projects High-rainfall environments Remote logistics operations Note: This role requires extensive field presence and the ability to work in remote Amazonian conditions with seasonal heavy rainfall, challenging terrain, and limited logistical support. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Ramo Industrial (CI) Descrição da Empresa A Mirandex começou sua história em meados de 1994, ainda como distribuidora de Vidros Brasil de Rondônia, atuando no ramo de distribuição de chapas e vidros em comum. Em 1998, começou a procura pelo vidro temperado no Estado, o que ainda era uma novidade. Desde então, começamos a revender o vidro temperado que era produzido nos grandes centros do país. O aumento da demanda, a dificuldade de compra e transporte, além do prazo de entrega, fizeram com que nos inspirássemos a montar uma indústria própria. Então em 2000, inauguramos nossa indústria de vidro temperado, a primeira do estado de Rondônia, com forno de têmpera vertical. Cada vez mais aquecido, o mercado exigia novos produtos e mais rapidez de entrega. Visando isso, em 2002 demos um grande passo ao adquirir um forno horizontal de tecnologia americana, que produzia vidros com mais rapidez e qualidade. Dessa forma, a Mirandex se torna a maior empresa do ramo vidraceiro da região Norte do Brasil. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — quectel.com Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil) Follow us on LinkedIn The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

vagas.title: English teacher
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando English teacher em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

vagas.title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

vagas.title: Full stack engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Full stack engineer em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

vagas.title: Especialista em governança de dados
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista em governança de dados em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Employment Type:Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You’ll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

This role is built for one thing and one thing only:Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

Company DescriptionOur organization is dedicated to empowering individuals to break free from traditional work models by building successful online businesses. Through a comprehensive training program, we provide tools and strategies for selling digital products, mastering digital marketing, and building trust in your brand. With modules covering topics like email marketing, content production, and affiliate marketing, we offer everything needed to create, launch, and grow an online business. Our mission is to help individuals gain financial freedom, work from anywhere, and achieve their personal and professional goals. Role DescriptionThis is a full-time remote role for a Trade Compliance Analyst. vagas.title: Senior revops analyst - churn
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior revops analyst - churn em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Contract Type:Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.About the Role We are seekinga Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churnto join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

vagas.title: Hardware engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Hardware engineer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

vagas.title: Project manager
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Project manager em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

vagas.title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us
